properties.name: get_node with a node_type says why an absent id is empty, and the empty-answer gate probes optional parameters
properties.rationale: fact:get-node-given-a-node-type-answers-an-absent-id-with-a-bare-null-2026-10-03, confirmed on main at 293f957: the widened gate reported exactly one BARE reply, `get_node +node_type {"node": null}`. THE CLASS: the gate probed required parameters only, so an optional parameter routing a read down another path was never asked; it now asks nine such probes and found no other bare empty.
properties.subject: system
properties.summary: get_node's typed path answers an absent id with empty_because, naming the type that does hold the id when one does; tools/empty_speaks.py asks every read again with each optional id- or type-shaped parameter filled, one at a time.
